title: Russo Brothers Acknowledge Risks of Their Avengers Return
excerpt:
The Endgame directors had reservations about returning.
They are tackling Doomsday and Secret Wars.
body_md:
Joe and Anthony Russo's return to Marvel has prompted mixed reactions. A new profile indicates that the directors themselves initially had reservations about accepting the assignment.

Following Infinity War and Endgame, the brothers are again responsible for a connected pair of Avengers films. Preserving the legacy of their earlier work while creating a new story is part of that challenge.

The report's headline points to their reluctance to interfere with a film audiences loved. The available excerpt does not include the complete interview, so further quotations or specific creative decisions cannot be established.
